mapper.select: SELECT id, username, onboarding_complete, avatar_id, created_at, email, password_hash FROM users WHERE username = #{identifier} OR email = #{identifier} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, onboarding_complete, avatar_id, created_at, email, password_hash FROM users WHERE id = #{id}::uuid LIMIT 1

UPDATE users
username = #{username}, onboarding_complete = #{onboardingComplete}, avatar_id = #{avatarId}, email = #{email}, password_hash = #{passwordHash},
WHERE id = #{id}::uuid RETURNING *

SELECT id, username, onboarding_complete, avatar_id, created_at, email, password_hash FROM users WHERE username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{identifier}, '%') OR email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{identifier}, '%') OR id::text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{identifier}, '%') AND LIMIT 1
